decisions.reason: The source concerns the SPS30 SEL pin at the sensor-module interface, not the power or signal connectors linking the three boards.

The candidate already specifies the SPS30 connector pin as SEL connected to GND; the source emphasizes that this connection must be hardwired but does not require changing the existing module-interface state.
Selecting the SPS30 I2C mode through its SEL pin does not alter the established 3.3V logic-level compatibility or level-shifter policy.
The SPS30 remains a load on the switched 5V sensor rail; grounding its SEL pin does not change its power-supply or rail-control requirements.
The SPS30 interface-mode selection is unrelated to the ESP32 BOOT and reset circuitry.
Hardwiring the SPS30 SEL pin to GND does not change which power rails are monitored or the current-monitoring coverage.
The SPS30 operating-interface mode does not change the standalone USB 3.3V regulator, source selection, or supported load requirement.
Requiring the SPS30 to operate in I2C mode does not change the bus speed, pull-ups, cable length, or series-resistor configuration.
The SPS30 SEL-pin connection has no effect on the addressable LED supply voltage or data-drive logic.
The SPS30 interface-mode selection does not alter the DCDC1 voltage setting or the required regulated 3.3V rail.
The SPS30 SEL-pin requirement is unrelated to the panel-mounted power-button connector and PWRON control behavior.
Hardwiring the SPS30 SEL pin does not change the selected ESP32 module or its full-pin breakout requirements.
